title: Remote artifact added without integrity check in dockerfile — review required
description: ADD with a URL downloads the artifact during the build. The download is not verified by a checksum unless the Dockerfile says so, so a compromised host serves different bytes into the image. COPY from a verified build stage, or download and check a digest explicitly.
remediation: Fetch the artifact in a builder stage, verify a pinned checksum or signature, then COPY the verified file into the final image.
limitation: Lexical: matches ADD with an http(s) URL; checksum verification elsewhere in the file is out of scope.
